recipes.name: Asparagus side dish (Asparagus-muchim: 아스파라거스무침)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar (or any distilled vinegar)
instructions: Bring a pot filled with 2 inches of water to a boil. Add the asparagus and blanch 1 to 2 minutes without the lid until bright green and a little soft, depending on the thickness of your asparagus. Remove from the heat.
Drain and rinse it under cold running water to clean and stop cooking. Drain and set aside.
Combine all the ingredients in a large mixing bowl and mix it well with a wooden spoon.
Add the asparagus and mix them well by hand or tongs.
Transfer to a plate and sprinkle more sesame seeds and serve with rice.

ingredient_sections.text: 1 large bunch (about 1 pound) of thin stem asparagus, trimmed
